Subject: Rolling enablement series + weekly drop-in office hours for ACME onboarding

Hi Ida —

Congrats on getting to the implementation kick-off milestone. To make the ramp predictable and keep engineering unblocked, we'd like to propose a short, structured enablement plan plus regular drop-in office hours. High-level plan attached and summarized below: 

- Kickoff workshop (90m): product overview, end-to-end demo, success criteria alignment.
- Deep-dive technical sessions (3 x 60m): API best practices, batching & cost controls, private deployment checklist.
- Weekly drop-in office hours (30m): open Q&A for engineers during initial 6 weeks.
- Recordings and written walkthroughs for every session; index in a shared playbook.

Attachments: enablement_agenda_v1.pdf, implementation-checklist_v1.xlsx

Proposed kickoff slots (PDT):
- Tue Oct 12, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Oct 13, 13:00–14:30

Can you confirm which works best and who from your team should be included? Also: do you prefer recordings to be shared immediately after each session or only on request?

Next steps after your confirmation: we’ll publish a calendar series for the weekly drop-ins and share an access-controlled folder with recordings and the playbook.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on the rollout.

Best,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
